summary_en: ROE target: double-digit (10%+) in FY3/27, lifting to 25%+ medium-term, exceeding 8% cost of equity. PBR maintained 1.0x+. Operating profit FY3/27 target ¥2,500M (record high). 'FUTURE VISION' 2035 long-term roadmap introduced. DX field transformation and specialist talent acquisition core drivers.
title_en: Measures toward realizing management conscious of cost of capital and stock price
translation_en_brief:
Members Co., Ltd. issued a capital-cost and shareholder-value update on 19 June 2026. The company articulated refreshed targets and policy following analysis of its path to sustainable growth and medium-term enterprise value creation.

Current state: Members has recovered ROE to FY3/23 levels (19.5% in FY3/26, ex-treasury), now exceeding its cost of equity (approx. 8%). For FY3/27 (final year of its medium-term strategy), the company targets double-digit ROE (at least 10%) and an operating profit of ¥2,500 million (record high). Medium-term aspiration is ROE of 25%+ on a sustained basis, continuously exceeding cost of capital. PBR has been maintained above 1.0x; the company acknowledges room for improvement versus historical levels and commits to PBR enhancement concurrent with profitability gains.

Strategy and vision: Members introduced a new long-term vision 'FUTURE VISION' targeting 2035, centred on 'Digital for Hope'—leveraging digital creativity to address climate and demographic challenges. The company positions itself as a partner in customers' DX internal-build journeys, deploying specialist talent (digital creators and business architects) in embedded, long-term engagement rather than traditional vendor delivery. Talent acquisition and retention of AI-utilization and DX specialists is identified as a core competitive advantage amid forecasted workforce shortages (3.39 million AI/robotics specialists short by 2040 in Japan).
